blocks.alt: Introducing Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data

blocks.text: 今天我们推出测试版的 Claude Whiteboards 和 Claude Sheets，同时 Claude Dashboards 正式转为通用可用版本，并更名为 Claude Data。Whiteboards 是一块共享画板，团队可以在上面和 Claude 一起头脑风暴；Sheets 是 Claude 与你共同搭建和编辑的电子表格；Claude Data 则新增了数据故事、认证查询和实时共享功能。这些功能在所有付费方案中均可使用。

inlines.text: 今天我们推出测试版的 Claude Whiteboards 和 Claude Sheets，同时
Claude Dashboards

blocks.text: 过去和 Claude 一起做项目，往往要把产出搬到另一个工具或程序里，而 Claude 在那里无法实时跟进进度和改动。现在，你的文档、画板、表格和仪表盘都可以留在 Claude 里，团队成员随时可以继续一起编辑。准备好之后，你还能把产出直接导入合作伙伴的工具，在那里接着做。

blocks.text: Claude Whiteboards

inlines.text: Claude Whiteboards

blocks.text: 很多人把 Claude 当作思考伙伴，但和它头脑风暴通常意味着要把结果复制粘贴到别处，才能开始和同事一起讨论或协作。现在，你可以直接对着 Claude 把还没理清的计划讲出来，Claude 能把它变成一块画板，附上时间线、负责人和日期，让你和团队实时协作。比如在复盘会上，每个人都可以写下自己的笔记，Claude 会按主题归类，并为每个人起草行动项。你还可以在画板上框选任意区域，向 Claude 提问，聚焦到那部分内容。头脑风暴结束后，Claude 可以把画板转成文档或演示文稿，或者导入 Lucid、Miro、Vani by Zoho 等工具，让你和团队继续在上面工作。

blocks.text: Claude Sheets

inlines.text: Claude Sheets

blocks.text: Claude 现在能生成带工作表标签、公式、格式和下拉菜单的电子表格，往往只需一句提示词，比如让它做一个营销活动跟踪表或招聘预算表。它可以直接在单元格里编辑，并逐条列出每处改动，方便你追踪变化。你可以把表格分享给团队，和 Claude 一起协作。

blocks.text: 目前表格只具备基础的电子表格功能，我们正在继续补充。当你需要 Excel 的完整功能时，可以把文件导出为 .xlsx 或 CSV，或者使用 Claude for Excel。你也可以在 Airtable、Asana、monday.com、Smartsheet 等合作伙伴工具中继续工作。

blocks.text: Claude Data

inlines.text: Claude Data

blocks.text: Claude Dashboards 于 10 月推出测试版，让团队可以在 Amazon Redshift、BigQuery、ClickHouse 等工具中快速查询公司数据。从今天起，它正式转为通用可用版本，并更名为 Claude Data。改名是因为企业对数据的使用范围远不止仪表盘，这款产品现在覆盖了更广泛的工作方式。认证查询和实时共享目前处于测试阶段。以下是团队使用 Claude Data 的几种方式：

inlines.text: Claude Dashboards
于 10 月推出测试版，让团队可以在 Amazon Redshift、BigQuery、ClickHouse 等工具中快速查询公司数据。从今天起，它正式转为通用可用版本，并更名为 Claude Data。改名是因为企业对数据的使用范围远不止仪表盘，这款产品现在覆盖了更广泛的工作方式。认证查询和实时共享目前处于测试阶段。以下是团队使用 Claude Data 的几种方式：
为指标建立认证定义。
你的数据团队可以认证大家应当使用的查询，避免出现基于互相冲突的数据搭建或使用仪表盘的情况。基于这些指标生成的图表会带有“已认证”徽章，表明它们已经过认证。
用数据讲故事。
你可以在 Claude Data 中与 Claude 协作，根据指标起草数据故事或旁白视频，分享前先由你审阅。
把当前数据分享给所有人。
开启实时共享后，同事打开共享仪表盘就能看到最新数据，即使他们没有访问那些维持数据更新的连接器的权限也没关系。查看者看到的是仪表盘结果，而非底层数据，并且只能运行你已批准的查询。
贴合你的视觉风格。
Claude Data 现已支持设计系统。
借助缓存加快加载速度。
以前每次加载仪表盘都会重新加载。现在仪表盘支持缓存，并且可以按仪表盘分别设置刷新频率。
追踪随时间发生的变化。
Claude Data 现在支持变更追踪，你可以看到谁做了修改，并在需要时回滚到特定版本。

blocks.alt: Introducing Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data

blocks.text: Today we’re launching Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets in beta, and Claude Dashboards becomes generally available as Claude Data. Whiteboards is a shared board where your team brainstorms with Claude, Sheets is a spreadsheet Claude builds and edits with you, and Claude Data adds data stories, certified queries, and live sharing. These are available on all paid plans.

Claude Dashboards

becomes generally available as Claude Data. Whiteboards is a shared board where your team brainstorms with Claude, Sheets is a spreadsheet Claude builds and edits with you, and Claude Data adds data stories, certified queries, and live sharing. These are available on all paid plans.

blocks.text: Working with Claude on a project often meant moving the output over to another tool or program, where Claude didn’t have live access to follow progress and changes. Now, your documents, boards, sheets, and dashboards can stay in Claude, with access for your team to continue editing together. When ready, you can bring the outputs directly into tools from our partners and continue working there.

blocks.text: Claude Whiteboards

inlines.text: Claude Whiteboards

blocks.text: Many people use Claude as a thought partner, but brainstorming with it has typically meant copy-pasting the results elsewhere so you can then start brainstorming or collaborating with your coworkers. Now, you can talk through a messy plan out loud with Claude, and Claude can turn it into a board with a timeline with owners and dates, so you and your team can collaborate in real time. In a retro meeting, for example, everyone can add their notes, and Claude can group them by theme and draft the action items for each person. You can focus on any part of the board by dragging a box around it and asking Claude questions. When you’re done brainstorming, Claude can turn the board into a doc or deck, or bring it into tools like Lucid, Miro, or Vani by Zoho, where you can continue working on it with your team.

blocks.text: Claude Sheets

inlines.text: Claude Sheets

blocks.text: Claude can now generate spreadsheets with tabs, formulas, formatting, and drop-downs, often from just a prompt like asking for a campaign tracker or a hiring budget. It can edit in the cells, outlining each new edit so you can track changes. You can share sheets with your team, so you and Claude can work on them together.

blocks.text: Claude Data

inlines.text: Claude Data

blocks.text: Claude Dashboards launched in beta in October, enabling teams to ask quick questions of their company’s data in tools like Amazon Redshift, BigQuery, and ClickHouse. Starting today, it’s generally available as Claude Data. We changed the name because the way companies use their data is broader than dashboards, and the product now covers how they work more broadly. Certified queries and live sharing are in beta. inlines.text: Claude Dashboards

launched in beta in October, enabling teams to ask quick questions of their company’s data in tools like Amazon Redshift, BigQuery, and ClickHouse. Starting today, it’s generally available as Claude Data. We changed the name because the way companies use their data is broader than dashboards, and the product now covers how they work more broadly. Certified queries and live sharing are in beta. Here are some ways teams can use Claude Data:
Create certified definitions of metrics.

Your data team can certify the queries everyone should use, so you don’t end up building or working on dashboards with conflicting data. Charts built on these metrics carry a "certified" badge showing they’re certified.
Craft stories
from data.
You can work with Claude in Claude Data to draft data stories or narrated videos from your metrics, for you to review before sharing.
Share current numbers with
everyone.

With live sharing, your colleagues can see up-to-date numbers when they open a shared dashboard, even if they don’t have access to the connectors that keep that data current. Viewers see dashboard results rather than the underlying data, and they can run only the queries you’ve approved.
Match your look-and-feel.
Design systems are now supported in Claude Data.
Get faster loading with caching.
Previously, every dashboard would reload on every load. Now, dashboards support caching, and refresh cadences can be set on a per-dashboard basis.
Track changes over time.
Claude Data now has tracked changes, so you can see who has made edits and roll back to a specific version if needed.
